title: Hoplite
description: Hopliite is one of the largest PvP Networks, with it's two game modes, Battle Royale and Duels.
body:
# ⚔️ Hoplite

**Hoplite** is the largest **Minecraft Battle Royale Server**, running on the **latest Minecraft versions**. Each match begins at the **Cornucopia**, where players scramble for starting loot before spreading out across the map to mine, explore, and prepare. After a 12 minute grace period, the fighting begins, until only one player or team is left standing!

During the preparation phase you can use many custom crafts that speed up progression and unlock unique abilities and playstyles. Find all the ingredients to craft **Legendary Weapons** to defeat your enemies and claim the victory. Play games to level up, upgrade your kits, and unlock free cosmetics!

Want to sharpen your skills before entering a full match? Hoplite also includes a **Duels mode**, where you can practice PvP and experiment with **Legendary Weapons** in fast, focused fights against other players.
